fixture: Wave 3 — demo-scenario transfers to the official x402 stack (Block D S10 DeliveryUncertain -> S-BS-16, Block D S11 OverBudget -> S-BS-17, secretariat S-ZS-02 first-accept-wins -> S-BS-18)
source_scenario_note: S10/S11 were designed and executed against agentmiddleware/amw-paypal-agent-demo (fiat rail, branch paypal-fiat-rails, seals #0001/#0002); S-ZS-02 was designed and executed against igor-vii/Zeus-Insurance-BOT zeus-secretariat (PG + mock stand). This fixture transfers each scenario to the x402 payment rail and runs it LIVE against the official @x402/* v2.28.0 client.

evidence_discipline.established: the client SIGNED and handed over an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization for the observed to/value (signer-call counts, to, value, nonce captured at the signer boundary); server-side payment captures (authorization handed over) with their nonce/value/to
evidence_discipline.not_established: an ON-CHAIN transfer or double-spend: settlement in this harness is mocked (fault-injection stand, not a facilitator); the client wallet is an unfunded one-shot test key, so no transfer could occur; 'double charge' wording is conditional on a real settle

reproduce.stand_cmd: argus run --block B --family BS --json --bind 0.0.0.0:<port> --observe-window-ms 4000 --skip-gate --scenario <S-BS-16|S-BS-17|S-BS-18|S-BS-02> --requirement-amounts '<A1,A2>' [--lost-response-at N | --expected-max-payments N | --malicious-first-accept '<json>']
reproduce.client_cmd: REQUEST_CYCLES=<n> SUT_CLIENT_MODE=<observe|control> [SUT_CLIENT_BUDGET_ATOMIC=<n>] [SUT_CLIENT_ALLOWED_PAYTO=<0x…,…>] npx tsx client_v4.ts  # env: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY (one-shot unfunded), RESOURCE_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<port>
reproduce.script: scripts/run_wave3_live.sh <session-part> (resumable, one Bash call per part)
reproduce.amounts_note: atomic units, USDC 6 decimals: 10000 = $0.01; spend-control maxAmountPerPayment=$1 = 1000000 atomic (official client default set by the harness)
